title: callistachys pulteneae
intro: Callistachys pulteneae, commonly known as the Indian milk bush, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Callistachys pulteneae include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
